## 1. SparrowDesk - Best for support calls unified with your helpdesk

sparrowdesk-call-center-software

Best for: Customer support teams that want phone calls in the same inbox as email, chat, and WhatsApp, with every call becoming a ticket.

Most call center tools treat the phone as its own system, separate from where your support team already works. SparrowDesk takes the opposite approach: it's an AI-first helpdesk with a built-in voice channel, so a phone call lands in the same inbox as every other conversation and becomes a ticket automatically, complete with recording and transcript. An agent answering a call already sees that customer's full history across channels, no separate phone system to reconcile. [...] For support teams specifically, the biggest shift in 2026 is that the phone no longer has to be a separate system. When calls become tickets in the same inbox as email and chat, and AI resolves the high-volume queries before they ever reach a call, your team spends its phone time on the conversations that genuinely need a voice. That's the job SparrowDesk is built for, which is why it leads this list for support-first teams.

results.title: SparrowDesk Expands Its Customer Service Platform with Voice Support
results.content:
\- Justin George, Business Unit Head, SparrowDesk

Bringing phone support into the shared inbox

SparrowDesk Voice allows agents to make and receive calls directly through the platform, without requiring a separate telephony provider account or desk phone. Businesses can purchase local, toll-free and mobile phone numbers in 51 countries, or contact SparrowDesk to explore porting an existing number.

Calls become conversations in the SparrowDesk inbox, alongside interactions from email, live chat and WhatsApp. Teams can review call details, track missed calls and voicemails, and access recordings and transcripts where configured. Calls can also be managed through the platform's existing assignment and automation workflows.

More flexibility in how calls are handled [...] # SparrowDesk Expands Its Customer Service Platform with Voice Support

New voice capabilities bring phone calls into the same shared inbox as email, live chat and WhatsApp, with AI-powered call handling and configurable call workflows.

CALIFORNIA CITY, CA / ACCESS Newswire / November 3, 2026 / SparrowDesk, the AI-first customer service platform, is expanding its support capabilities with the introduction of voice, bringing phone calls into the same workspace where teams manage customer conversations across email, live chat and WhatsApp. [...] Phone remains a key part of customer service, yet calls can sit outside the workflows teams use to manage other customer interactions. With SparrowDesk Voice, businesses can handle incoming and outgoing calls within the platform, keeping call information alongside conversations from other channels rather than managing phone support through a separate system.

"Customer service teams need to manage conversations across channels without losing the context of each interaction. Bringing voice into SparrowDesk extends the same shared workspace to phone support, while giving teams the flexibility to configure call handling around their needs. It brings another important part of the customer service experience into the platform."

\- Justin George, Business Unit Head, SparrowDesk
